text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — inference-gateway: 5xx-rate spike in us-west1 (threshold 3%) — current 5.8% — auto-page to SRE rotation (pd-incident/urgent). See PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 — Acknowledgement pending. Trigger rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 3% for 5m. Attached: sample traces, top paths.

amanda: acked — taking lead. oncall here. grabbing dashboards now.

raj: thanks. any customer impact on the status page?

jess: synthetic checks show 502/503 from edge -> gateway. top path /v1/generate. error distribution: 502: ~72%, 504: ~18%, 500s: rest. latency increased by ~200ms p95.

jess: quick prod query (from grafana alert panel):
```
sum by(status) (rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",region="us-west1"}[1m]))
```
shows the spike.

paul: is this isolated to us-west1? region routing should failover but we see some sticky routing from edge.

amanda: checking routing table and k8s pods. if pods OOM or crashloop we'd see restarts.

tilly: i'm going to temporarily route traffic away from the problem pool — canary 10% to eu-west1 and keep watch. starting in 30s.

amanda: quick mitigation options:
- bump gateway replicas in us-west1 (scale pool + drain unhealthy pods)
- enable fallback-route to model-variant-small for latency-sensitive customers
- enforce short-term rate limit on non-authenticated routes (reduce noisy bursters)
pick one, i'll action.

raj: can we flip fallback-route? that has smallest blast radius. do we have telemetry for quality drop?

paul: fallback-route is configured. command to flip (internal tool):
```
redwoodctl route apply --route /v1/generate --fallback-model rdlw/small:2026-01 --region us-west1 --traffic 100
```
use cautious ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100).

amanda: flipping to 10% now. monitor logs for 1m.

incident-bot: update — fallback-route 10% enabled for /v1/generate in us-west1.

jess: logs show reduced 5xx on the subset: 10% traffic -> 5xx for that cohort down to ~0.3%. overall still ~4.9% though.

tilly: starting canary reroute to eu-west1 (10%). will post when complete.

amanda: scaling gateway replicas by +3 in us-west1 (k8s HPA override).

amanda: kubectl snippet: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment gateway-usw1 --replicas=12
kubectl get pods -n inference -w | grep gateway-usw1
```

paul: thumbs on also rotating a handful of edge boxes to clear sticky connections.

jess: note: some 502s are coming from internal KV-cache timeouts — tracking query:
```
rate(kv_cache_request_errors_total{service="gateway"}[5m])
```
looks elevated, filing follow-up to eng-runtime.

amanda: initial customer-impact: status page shows degraded for some customers, we have 7 reported errors in the last 15m (support channel). not yet widespread but could escalate.

pagerduty-bot: INC12345 — acknowledged by amanda. escalation suppressed. next on-call: paul (30m).

tilly: canary to eu-west1 done — that cohort stable. 5xx there ~0.2%.

amanda: after scale + fallback + canary, global 5xx back down to 1.2% in us-west1 over last 5m. continuing to monitor.

jess: I'll open a follow-up ticket for KV cache investigation and link traces. TAG: eng-runtime.

amanda: action items so far:
- short-term: fallback-route 100% if things regress (paul/tilly)
- mid-term: rollback bad deploy if we find one (amanda)
- follow-up: eng-runtime to investigate kv_cache errors (jess)

paul: I'll stay on for handoff still. if stable in 45m we can close pager.

incident-bot: update — incident status: mitigated (reduction in 5xx to acceptable threshold). monitors set to extended watch for 1h.

amanda: leaving detailed timeline + commands in INC12345. paging for now remains open until handoff completed. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
